sloka: अनावृष्टिः सुघोरा वै सर्वलोक भयाअवहा ।अनावृष्ट्याम् तु वृत्तायाम् राजा दुःख समन्वितः ॥१-९-९॥
transliteration: anāvṛṣṭiḥ sughorā vai sarvaloka bhayāavahā ।anāvṛṣṭyām tu vṛttāyām rājā duḥkha samanvitaḥ ॥1-9-9॥

translations.english: With drought prevailing, the griefstricken king, would summon all those grown old with learning and tell them.
